agreed: 2026-11-21 (section 4 step F, row 67.17 part 2: SERVICES UPDATE 67.2 and 67.8, the office side in LynkAcc)
rule: The office side of money a shop takes or owes before or around a sale. Gift cards and store credit are a debt of the shop in LynkAcc, never held by LynkOmni; a deposit is received in advance until it is used, kept under terms shown before, or returned; every payment is matched to its sale, invoice or booking, and anything unmatched is listed; every payment shows what it cost (the provider's fee and LynkOmni's part); the payout calendar shows when each provider's money arrives. Money is whole minor units. Facts about electronic money come only from the provider. Rules live in core/office_money.py and ts/src/officemoney.ts (python3 tools/office_money_vectors.py after a change); the cloud service is services/office_money.py.

gift_card.note: sold and topped up at the till or online; the money taken is owed to the holder

store_credit.note: given for a return, as cashback or as goodwill; owed to the customer

stored_value.offline: A device may sell, top up and spend offline; a sale is never blocked. When the cloud finds a balance spent below nothing it flags StoredValueConflictFlagged for the owner and posts nothing extra.
stored_value.expiry: never, until the country's rule is confirmed (country pack office.gift_cards, lawyer)
stored_value.cash_out: never through LynkOmni; a refund of a balance, where the law requires it, goes through the shop's own till or the licensed provider (built with the screens in section 7)

applied.note: the goods or service were given; the deposit becomes part of the sale

kept.note: kept only under terms the customer was shown before paying (a no-show, damage on a rental)

returned_cash.note: given back in cash at the till

deposits.returned_electronic: DepositRefunded, written by the cloud only when the provider confirms the refund
deposits.rule: A deposit settles at most what is still held; a part kept and a part returned are two settlements.

matching.rule: A provider's payment is matched by its reference first. Without a reference, a single open target with the same amount and currency within the window is a suggestion a person confirms (or the Plus automation settlement-match accepts, undoable). Two or more candidates are never guessed. Anything left is listed as unmatched.

costs.rule: Both come from the provider's settlement report; LynkOmni's part is what the provider took for LynkOmni under the shop's plan, never worked out on the device. Shown per payment and per month; the month is the settlement's date in UTC.

payouts.rule: Expected and arrived come only from the provider. A payout is late when it has not arrived two days after its expected date; late is shown to the owner, never claimed as lost.

tiers: Every tier records gift cards, store credit, deposits, costs and payouts and can match by hand; automatic matching from Plus (billing FEATURES lynkacc auto_match).

build.4: registers, rules, contract version 16, the cloud service and the books
build.7: the customer side of gift cards and store credit
